C-51.IntentSummary: Docs look for this release: tree + Recent/Pinned, Mermaid and content themed by the app theme, always-visible expand, Docs and macOS families. Implemented by ZCode agents in worktrees; the orchestrator reviews against spec/plan/graph/tests, proves new tests red on main, runs full gates and merges.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Tree matches canvas Main/DocsDark in every theme: line folder icon (open/closed), name, chevron right; nested guide lines; current file on a soft pill; folder switcher row at the top. Uses M-057 icons and the chrome font/accent tokens.

Markdown-only by default: the initial walk (Rust walk_and_emit_inner) and the watcher path apply the same rule; folders with no Markdown anywhere below are hidden and appear when a Markdown file is created inside. Settings › Files «Show all files» (off) restores everything (non-Markdown dimmed, not openable as today).

Tests: Rust walk filter (md-only, all, nested empty dirs); renderer tree model (hide/show folders as files come and go); e2e chromium + webkit: opened folder shows only .md, toggle shows all, creating an .md in an empty folder reveals it.

T-002.Title: Recent and Pinned sidebar sections (R-1a)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Recent (existing recent list, up to 10, newest first) and Pinned (persisted list; pin/unpin from tree and tab context menus; drag to reorder) above the tree, each collapsible; missing files greyed with Remove; clicking opens the file. All strings in 10 locales.
Tests: store (pin/unpin/reorder/persist/missing), component, e2e both engines.

T-002.ReviewEvidence: T-001 + T-002, orchestrator review 2026-10-16. The filter lives in the renderer view (store/treeFilter.js), so «Show all files» is instant and the Rust walk is unchanged; the watcher now adds non-Markdown files too, so both paths agree. Review fixes: a pre-existing root-chevron bug (toggleRootDirectories stored !expanded as the collapsed flag — the root never collapsed; caught by the new test, also broken on main); e2e emit helper used an outer variable inside page.evaluate (every tree event was dropped), prefs snapshot called on the page object, strict-mode locators, the show-all assertion targeted a file inside a collapsed folder, the screenshots wrote into the repo's screenshots/ (now test outputPath) and the Ink shot was actually light (theme now switched via the title bar); unit tests missing the Pinia/setupTestPinia imports, a Playwright-only .first(), a stat mock rejecting with an Error instead of Tauri's structured object, an import-time window.electron read; tab context-menu tests needed Pinia (the menu reads the pinned store). Visual: the current-file pill is inset (it ran edge to edge) with the name kept aligned, the accent bar dropped (overlapped the icon), Recent/Pinned no longer repeat the pill, folder hover inset. Gates: vitest 286 files / 3880 passed; grace lint 0; Playwright chromium + webkit 406 passed (2 load timeouts passed on rerun); sidebar e2e 22/22 both engines. Red on main: the six new unit files fail; sidebar-tree-redesign.spec 11/11 fail. WebKit screenshots Paper + Ink.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Reference implementation: the accepted round-2/3 lab (scratch c51-mermaid-lab-palette.js — OKLCH 8-colour categorical palette per theme from the accent hue: tints for areas, series colours for lines/bars/sectors; per-diagram-type config; quadrant one hue by lightness; architecture icon tiles/glyphs repainted via attribute-selector CSS; C-4 colours via the c4 config keys; sankey keeps its gradient links, value labels spaced, normal blending on dark themes only). mermaidPipeline builds config from the active theme: look neo, theme base/neo, themeVariables from the theme CSS variables (incl. cScale0–11, pie1–12, git0–7, xyChart.plotColorPalette, quadrant fills, journey fillType/actor), UI font; themeCSS polish; layout config. Cache key includes the theme; theme switch re-renders; export uses the same config.

Per-type e2e matrix (chromium + webkit): every one of the 22 types renders without error in a light and a dark theme; computed node fill/stroke/text colours come from the theme (no #ECECFF / #9370DB purple, no Trebuchet); group-2 types use distinct palette colours; screenshots attached per type.

T-004.Title: Mermaid group 3: readable sizes and non-themeable types (R-2a)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: gantt, journey, packet, timeline render with text ≥ 11 px in the default column (type sizing; otherwise horizontal scroll inside the block + expand); sankey node colours from the palette and «Drafts 75» value spacing; C-4 best effort via themeCSS. Tests per type measure label font size and colours.

T-004.ReviewEvidence: T-003 + T-004, orchestrator review 2026-10-16. Fixes: colour parsing fed 0..255 channels into the 0..1 hex writer (every theme colour came out #ffffff/#ffff00 — product bug; regression test added); theme variables read from the root's inline mirror first (jsdom computed custom properties unreliable); explicit mainBkg/nodeBorder dropped so Mermaid derives them from primaryColor; the %%{init}%% e2e now uses the form Mermaid 11.14 honours (themeVariables only together with an explicit theme — verified in the lab); journey/gitGraph Trebuchet labels forced to the theme font; the 22-diagram count ignores nested icon SVGs. Added after the user's renders feedback: per-type arrowhead scaling (postProcessMermaidSvg — «не конские стрелки»; markers without a viewBox get one first), Keynote-style pie (background-coloured separators, no outer ring, white semibold labels), theme-defined chart palette hook (--chartPalette, for the macOS family's Apple system colours) included in the cache signature. Gates: vitest 280 files / 3840 passed; grace lint 0; Playwright chromium + webkit 386 passed; mermaid-theme spec 16/16. Red on main: the two new unit files fail to load; mermaid-theme.spec 7/8 fail (the init-override guard passes on main by design). In-app WebKit screenshots Paper + Ink (flowchart, sequence, pie, mindmap, xychart, block, kanban, radar).

T-005.Title: Other content themed: Vega-Lite, flowchart.js, sequence, KaTeX (R-3)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Vega-Lite gets a config from the theme palette/font; flowchart.js and js-sequence colours from the theme; KaTeX inherits text colour; e2e checks computed colours in a light and a dark theme.

T-005.ReviewEvidence: Orchestrator review 2026-10-16. Vega-Lite, flowchart.js, js-sequence and KaTeX follow the theme tokens and palette (contentTheme.js; chartPalette shared with Mermaid). Review fixes: js-sequence's «hand» theme draws after its web font loads, so the repaint ran on an empty SVG and the text stayed black — now applySequenceThemeWhenDrawn repaints again on SVG mutations (bounded), with one observer per container so a theme switch never repaints with stale tokens (caught by the unit test); the repaint writes inline styles (attributes lost to js-sequence's styles); e2e imported muya ESM sources Playwright cannot load — expected colours now come from tests/e2e/fixtures/chartPalette.ts, pinned to muya by a parity unit test; e2e counted the transparent vega background as a bar and expected / where the hand theme draws ; export unit tests never handed their container to the exporter. Gates: vitest 291 files / 3940 passed; grace lint 0; Playwright chromium + webkit 420 passed; content-theme 6/6 both engines. Red on main: the two new unit files fail to load; content-theme.spec 3/3 fail. Screenshots Paper + Ink: vega bar/line, flowchart, sequence.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Top-right expand button on Mermaid, Vega-Lite, flowchart.js, sequence, PlantUML blocks and tables: visible at rest (subtle), solid on hover, keyboard-focusable with an aria-label in 10 locales, opens the C-34 viewer; does not cover content (reserved corner). e2e both engines.

Four themes (Docs light/dark, macOS light/dark) in the C-41 family model and picker, matching canvas Main/DocsDark/MacOS; contrast checks pass; Mermaid/content theming derives from them; 10 locales for names.

T-008.Title: Live macOS smoke of the release

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Isolated smoke build (own identifier, HOME, target dir): title bar, outline rail, status bar, lock, chrome font/accent/icons, Settings, View-menu checkmarks, column resize, tree + Recent/Pinned, Mermaid in 4 themes, expand; screenshots; no change to the user's Mark.app.

T-009.Title: Agent prompt lists every rich-Markdown feature Mark renders (user 2026-10-16)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: guide.agentPrompt.mac / .generic in all 10 locales carry the user-approved text (EN source in the task brief; macOS variant with open -a Mark, generic «open it for the user in Mark»); real translations keep every syntax token (```mermaid, the 22 type keywords, ```vega-lite, ```flowchart, ```sequence, [!NOTE]…[!CAUTION] and the alias names, - [ ], $…$, $$…$$, [^1]) verbatim. PlantUML and super/subscript are deliberately not listed.
The Guide (static/guide/*.md, 10 locales) gains a compact «What Mark renders» showcase section with a live example of each feature family.

Honesty guard: an e2e renders a fixture with one example of EVERY feature named in the prompt (all 22 Mermaid types, vega-lite, flowchart, sequence, every callout tag incl. title and fold, task list, inline/block math, code fence, footnote, front matter, emoji, table, link, image) in chromium + webkit and asserts each rendered (svg / katex / callout / checkbox / footnote nodes) with no render error; a unit test pins that every locale's prompt contains the same syntax tokens as EN.

T-009.ReviewEvidence: Orchestrator review 2026-10-16: EN mac prompt byte-identical to the user-approved text; 10 locales keep every syntax token. The agent found and fixed a real export bug: a fenced block containing ``` was re-exported with a 3-backtick fence and tore open (the prompt block in the Guide) — exportMarkdown now uses a longer fence than any inner backtick run. Review fixes: two of the 22 honesty-guard Mermaid samples were invalid (architecture edge needs ports «app:R --> L:db», treemap labels need quotes) and the SVG count included nested icon SVGs; a unit test expected the prompt without its final period; the CI WebKit step had lost webkit-mermaid-theme and webkit-tree in earlier merges — restored together with webkit-rich; scenario numbering de-duplicated (T-009 = scenario-59). Gates: vitest 288 files / 3916 passed; grace lint 0; Playwright chromium + webkit 411 + rich 6/6 (one settings test timed out under load, passed on rerun). Red on main: agent-prompt-rich + export-fence-length 34/36 fail; the Guide e2e fails; the two coverage e2e pass on main by design (they guard what already renders).

T-005.Notes: ZCode agent (worktree agent/c51-t5) implemented 2026-10-16; gates to be run by the orchestrator (agent has no shell). Design notes: new src/muya/lib/parser/render/contentTheme.js builds the Vega-Lite embed config (background null so the block CSS --codeBlockBgColor panel shows through, theme font, axis domain/tick/grid = border, labels/titles = muted, chart title/text marks = text, rule marks = line, mark default colour + range.category = chartPalette), the flowchart.js drawSVG options (line-color/element-color/fill/font-color/font-family) and the js-sequence drawSVG options (hand/simple preference passed through; only 'simple' gets the theme font — 'hand' keeps danielbd); js-sequence's hard-coded #000/#fff SVG is repainted after drawSVG by applySequenceTheme (text = text token, connectors + arrowhead markers = line, boxes = surface/border, notes = Mermaid's noteBkg tint pair, hand-theme boxes distinguished from lifelines by their non-"none" fill). mermaidTheme.js exports chartPalette(tokens) as the single palette definition (buildMermaidThemeConfig/mermaidThemeSignature now compute through it — identical values, existing tests unchanged). StateRender.renderDiagram and ExportHtml.renderDiagram read readActiveThemeTokens at render time and log [Muya][renderDiagram][BLOCK_DIAGRAM_THEME]; the named vega themes (latimes/dark) and the vegaTheme muya option consumption are gone (the option stays in the API exactly like mermaidTheme after T-003; editor.vue's theme watcher still drives the re-render via setOptions(..., true)); the sequence path no longer crashes on a null muya in export. User spec config wins: vega-lite compile applies mergeConfig(opt.config, inputSpec.config) (verified in node_modules) — sub-objects replace wholesale; pinned with vega's own mergeConfig in unit tests and a user-config chart in the e2e. KaTeX needed no code: katex.css sets no colour and the muya math styles use var(--editorColor) — pinned in the e2e (inline + display math colour = theme text in paper and ink). Tests: tests/renderer/muya/content-theme.test.js (chartPalette sharing incl. --chartPalette, vega config values + user-wins via vega mergeConfig, flowchart options, sequence options + SVG repaint incl. notes/markers/hand boxes, StateRender wiring incl. paper→ink re-render and the error placeholder) and tests/renderer/muya/export-content-theme.test.js (export wiring, dark tokens, muya sequenceTheme, error placeholder) — both fail against the pre-T-005 renderDiagram. E2e tests/e2e/content-theme.spec.ts runs in chromium (full suite) and the new webkit-content-theme playwright project (CI step extended): bar fill = palette hue 0 (≠ #4c78a8), two line series = palette hues 0/1, vega text fills ∈ {muted, text} and never black, axis strokes = border, flowchart connectors = line colour + shapes = surface, sequence text readable on dark + note tint, KaTeX = theme text colour, paper → ink re-renders vega; screenshots via test.info().outputPath. No locale strings added.

T-009.Notes: ZCode agent (worktree agent/c51-t9) implemented 2026-10-16; gates to be run by the orchestrator (agent has no shell). Design notes: the approved EN prompt ships as guide.agentPrompt.mac (open -a Mark <file>.md) and .generic (prose "…in Mark.") in all ten static/locales/*.json — real translations, every syntax token verbatim; the texts contain no {}/@/| so the app's vue-i18n message compiler passes them unchanged ($ is not special outside {} placeholders, verified against the bundled @intlify/message-compiler), and tests/renderer/util/agent-prompt-rich.test.js renders getAgentPrompt for every locale through the REAL app i18n instance asserting every token (```mermaid, the 22 type keywords, ```vega-lite/```flowchart/```sequence, the callout tag list + alias list, - [ ]/- [x], $…$, $$…$$, [^1], :shortcodes:, the mac open command) plus the generic variant dropping it. static/guide/*.md ×10: the prompt block became a FOUR-backtick fence (the prompt names ``` fences — a 3-backtick fence would close at ```mermaid), and a «What Mark renders» showcase section (one live example per feature family) was inserted AFTER connect-agent so getGuideSectionHeadingText's first-## deep link is unchanged; existing try-it sections untouched. Load-bearing muya fix: exportMarkdown normalizeCodeBlock now emits a fence longer than the longest backtick run inside the block (BLOCK_FENCE_LENGTH_KEEP) — a fixed ``` export would re-import the guide with the prompt block torn open on Save As / Copy as Markdown; blocks without inner ``` runs stay byte-identical (pinned in tests/renderer/muya/export-fence-length.test.js incl. a full guide open/save round trip). Honesty guard tests/e2e/rich-markdown-coverage.spec.ts (chromium full-suite + new webkit-rich project, CI renderer-e2e WebKit step extended): 22 mermaid samples (gantt avoids a task named «Title …»), vega-lite/flowchart/sequence, 15 callouts (5 GitHub + 10 further tags, custom title, - and + folds), task list, inline+block math, rust fence, footnote, front matter props, :tada:, link, data:-URI image, aligned table — per-feature render assertions (svg counts, zero .ag-mermaid-error/.ag-math-error, callout classes/title/fold classes, checkbox counts incl. ag-checkbox-checked, .katex inline+display, sup.ag-inline-footnote-identifier + FOOTNOTE figure, ag-front-matter-table, data-emoji char, computed th alignment) plus a Guide test pinning the prompt block and showcase rendering. The orchestrator must regenerate static/locales/*.min.json (locale tables changed; the runner bundles .min.json). PlantUML and super/subscript stay deliberately unlisted.
